messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, then slowly turns their head and upper body to the left, before turning back to face away from the camera.","camera":"The camera is static, framing the person from the waist up in a medium shot from behind.","clothing":"The person wears a dark, long-sleeved top with a high collar and a dark skirt or wide trousers, with a belt at the waist.","hair_color":"The hair appears dark brown or black, though it is mostly in shadow.","hairstyle":"The person's hair is pulled back into a high ponytail or topknot.","identity":"A person with a slim build is seen mostly from behind, with a brief side profile revealing a short beard and jawline.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace or balcony overlooking a calm body of water under a clear, bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output reframes the same rear view to a tighter upper-body/medium shot, cropping out most of the lower legs and foreground stones. The person remains centered, the same turn-to-the-left and return motion occurs in a similar sequence, and the terrace, water, sky, and clothing remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing while preserving the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the initial framing exactly matches the reference image's subject placement and crop.
unexpected_changes: The output has visible black bars on the left and right edges, changing the apparent aspect ratio compared with the source.
